Whether you’re looking for sweet little lullabies to soothe your baby or city sounds to lull you off to sleep. Nature, from lightning storm to squawking birds to waves crashing, is well represented. True white noise is also offered. I have only one complaint and that is that you aren’t able to sample the various tracks before downloading them and you pick based on a photo. A picture may saw a thousand words but it may not always be the best way to describe a sound. Download times can be up to two minutes (longer if you have especially bad WiFi) so samplers would really help. Deleting unwanted sounds is very easy though.
